scope: Optional extension of the existing measurement harness only; no production source, product limits, runtime dependencies, workflow or ref changes.

implementation.default_mode: Existing ordinary-import CLI/default fields/three-phase reports remain; additional optional fields are present only when selected.
implementation.fixture_setup: RetainedAssets.retain, Catalog/register_batch and Storage.stage_revision under exclusive_writer and bounded SQLite transactions; <=250 books and <=16 MiB declared source per transaction; no fabricated import journal or publication receipt.
implementation.fixture_ready: Full Storage.check and every actual retained-source digest/catalog identity must pass before corpus.json is published.
implementation.ordinary_operations: 3..20 actual public import samples and exact retries in another workspace against the same populated DB; changed original under the same immutable edition must be refused without changing its prior receipt.
implementation.recovery: Actual plan_import_batch/run_import_batch owned worker stops after >=2 durable checkpoints; its resource leases settle; generated external source is removed; fresh LibraryApp resumes the same retained request and reconciles the batch; terminal repeat preserves exact immutable publication receipt.
implementation.backup: Explicit optional current app.backup/verify_backup/restore_backup with unchanged actual limits and conservative measured disk admission; only owned synthetic source root is renamed; new target must preserve complete catalog and selected original/reader identity.
implementation.unsupported_backup: NOT_ADMITTED is PARTIAL, never backup PASS. Current asset cap excludes even 10,000 selected fixture books plus the isolation original; no larger profile is invented.
implementation.phase_contract: Existing schema remains carr-library-corpus-benchmark/1. Optional operations and backup have separate owned phase interpreters. Every selected phase must PASS, be reaped and share exact corpus/source/kernel identities.
implementation.bounds: Original finite books/segments/source/JSON/disk/free-space/phase bounds remain. Source byte and SQLite VM checkpoints remain cancellable.
implementation.limits_of_measurement: Fixture setup and bounded public samples do not prove sustained whole-corpus import throughput. Whole-process RSS is the phase interpreter; nested import worker RSS is NOT_MEASURED. Direct-phase emergency termination is not process-family cleanup qualification.

reuse.retained_recipe: Existing <=250 transactional Catalog/Storage fixture construction; current source/cursor/API/receipt/backup contracts retained.

required_validation.count_basis: 12 literal test functions, one parametrized over seven options; NOT_COLLECTED.
required_validation.runtime_requirements: Existing normal application/test closure and SQLite FTS5; actual TXT owned-import child; no FFmpeg, OCR binary, network, model or device required.
required_validation.installed_requirement: Preserve companion relative paths and exact bytes. Invoke installed Python -I -B with source injection disabled. Actual CLI fixture chooses --installed when the current application origin is installed and requires that exact path; child imports remain source/byte bound.
required_validation.mandatory_outcome: Every whole suite must collect/run with zero skips/XFAIL/XPASS. Existing CI600 per-suite envelope unchanged; no test-only capacity shortcuts or limit monkeypatches.
required_validation.native_gui: NOT_APPLICABLE; this is a real headless library measurement, no GUI/acoustic claim.

cli.two_million_profile: Same explicit retained fixture command with --sizes 50000 --segments-per-book 40; other declared parameters unchanged.
cli.backup_option: --complete-backup, only after explicit ordinary supported capacity/disk admission; source reporting distinguishes refusal.

previous_baseline.status: SEPARATE_ACTUAL_EVIDENCE; does not qualify this extension

peer_review.scope: Current public API, retained cancellation/resume/batch reconciliation, phase ownership/report and backup API seam; direct hard-timeout tree limit explicitly unqualified.
Exact retained seed/schema/transaction/full-audit/source ownership, new tests and current backup admission/retirement/restore seam.
